parameters.query: SELECT q.id, q.quote_number, q.contact_id, q.conversation_id, q.created_at, q.status, q.sent_at, c.display_name, c.phone, c.email, c.business_id, b.waha_session_name FROM quotes q JOIN contacts c ON q.contact_id = c.id JOIN businesses b ON b.id = c.business_id WHERE q.status = 'sent' AND q.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND q.sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND q.sent_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '25 hours' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = q.conversation_id AND m.created_at > q.sent_at AND m.sender_type = 'staff') LIMIT 10;

SELECT q.id, q.quote_number, q.contact_id, q.conversation_id, q.created_at, q.status, q.sent_at, c.display_name, c.phone, c.email FROM quotes q JOIN contacts c ON q.contact_id = c.id WHERE q.status = 'sent' AND q.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND q.sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days' AND q.sent_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days 1 hour' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = q.conversation_id AND m.created_at > q.sent_at AND m.sender_type = 'staff' AND m.metadata->>'follow_up_type' = '3day') LIMIT 10;

SELECT q.id, q.quote_number, q.contact_id, q.conversation_id, q.created_at, q.status, q.sent_at, c.display_name, c.phone, c.email FROM quotes q JOIN contacts c ON q.contact_id = c.id WHERE q.status = 'sent' AND q.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND q.sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND q.sent_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days 1 hour' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = q.conversation_id AND m.created_at > q.sent_at AND m.sender_type = 'staff' AND m.metadata->>'follow_up_type' = '7day') LIMIT 10;
INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, sender_type, message_type, text_body, metadata, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'outgoing', 'staff', 'text', $2, $3, NOW(), NOW());

INSERT INTO audit_logs (entity_type, entity_id, action, performed_by, performed_by_type, description, new_values, metadata) VALUES ('quote', $1::uuid, 'automated_follow_up', 'system', 'automation', $2, jsonb_build_object('follow_up_type', $3), jsonb_build_object('quote_number', $4, 'contact_id', $5::uuid, 'timestamp', NOW())) RETURNING id;

parameters.jsCode:
const items = $input.all();
return items.map(item => ({ json: { ...item.json, success: true, message: `Follow-up sent for quote ${item.json.quote_number} to ${item.json.display_name || item.json.phone}` } }));
